behavioral_changes: Qualification policy has a durable active version/hash/payload for Continuous runs
Qualification-only YAML edits activate only at a no-unfinished-batch safe checkpoint before new allocation
Restart/recovery restores the durable active Qualification payload before classification

Non-Qualification drift is rejected by the C3 controller without replacing the last known-good policy
Successful reload emits durable from/to version/hash attribution and does not affect Simulation identity
Repeated identical rejected candidate policies are telemetry-idempotent
